answer: Bind each agent identity to one device with a TPM quote, listed in a shared registry. First, a new agent submits its device quote and gets exactly one identity; a second quote from the same chip is rejected, so no device bridges two identities. Second, fresh identities work only from the wharf, capped at five-dollar jobs for six epochs. Third, one proven fraud burns the binding, blacklisting the hardware. A thousand-fake farm needs a thousand real devices, fifty thousand dollars, before earning a cent. A sybil farm is yarrow planted on concrete: plenty of shoots, nothing takes root.
